#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    vector<int> digits(101);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; ++i) {
        digits[i] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    }

    int carry = 0;
    bool valid = true;

    for (int i = 0; i <= 100 && valid; ++i) {
        int current = digits[i] + carry;
        carry = current / w;
        current %= w;

        if (current == 0 || current == 1) {
            continue;
        }
        if (current == w - 1) {
            carry = 1;
        } else {
            valid = false;
        }
    }

    cout << (valid && carry != 1 ? "YES" : "NO");
    return 0;
}
